_about: Henry van Dyke's Christmas legends and tales: The Story of the Other Wise Man (Harper, copyright 1895, 1899), The Lost Word (New York, MDCCCXCVIII), The First Christmas Tree (Scribner; undated in the text), The Blue Flower (dedication dated December 1, 1902), The Sad Shepherd (copyright 1911). The Blue Flower collects seven stories, three of them also here as separate books (its Lost Word, First Christmas-Tree and Other Wise Man share 75%, 62% and 50% of their long paragraphs with the separate books); per the containment rule both are kept and the overlap mints once with two witnesses. Its First Christmas-Tree numbers its sections I, II, IV: section III's heading is missing from the Gutenberg text, so its paragraphs run on under II. His poems, essays and addresses are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
